item.title: mercadolibre.com.co: 50. The gap: AI crawler access.
item.description:
Every internal link that was opened answered, and model-training crawlers are blocked by choice. But 5 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.
The lesson for every team: Decide per bot in robots.txt: allow the answer engines you want to be cited by, and block only training crawlers.
One automated analysis of public pages on 21 Oct 2026, requested through QA-lab URL Review. A starting point, not a verdict. The full report: https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review.html?live=u-mercadolibre-com-co&utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=requested-reviews&utm_content=u-mercadolibre-com-co
#GEO #AISearch #RobotsTxt #QA #QAlab

item.title: pirouline.com: 74. The gap: framing.
item.description:
Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But other sites can frame the page.
The lesson for every team: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in the CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, so other sites cannot frame your pages.
One automated analysis of public pages on 22 Oct 2026, requested through QA-lab URL Review. A starting point, not a verdict. #WebSecurity #Clickjacking #HTTPHeaders #QA #QAlab

item.title: epssura.com: 40. The gap: form labels.

The lesson for every team: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
